prompt:
Create a production inventory sprite atlas for the same Greek fantasy RPG as the reference. Exactly SIX separate equipment icons on a 1536 by 1024 canvas, three columns by two rows, each cell 512 square. Each object is a distinct authored shape with detailed painterly metal and leather, matching the reference rendering style. Items must fit completely within their own cell with 45 pixels of empty transparent padding on EVERY side. No touching cell borders, no overlapping adjacent objects. Isolated object cutouts on a TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA background. No surface, backdrop, plate, colored glow cloud, shadow panel, text, numbers, borders, UI, characters or hands. Crisp clean antialiased edges; all openings and gaps are fully transparent.
Each icon is exactly ONE matched PAIR of short assassin daggers crossed in a readable X. Two complete short blades with separate grips, compact silhouette. Transparent negative spaces between blades. They are SHORT DAGGERS, not full length swords.
Order left to right, top then bottom: T7 Styx blackened silver with small teal river gemstone; T8 oracle ivory gold sun motif with sapphire; T9 Titan massive bronze geometric edges with obsidian and blue gem; T10 cloudgate elegant silver cloud curves and ice gem; T11 Elysium white gold laurel with pearl and green gem; T12 cosmos navy star steel with gold constellations and sapphire.
